title: Training Notes, Retail Installment Contracts: The Amount a Late Charge Is Figured On
content:
On a contract under Retail Installment Contracts the amount the late-charge rate applies to depends on the installment being charged.

**Rule.** For the final installment, whose due date equals the contract's final installment date (maturity date), the amount is the lesser of the scheduled installment and the principal balance plus the unpaid interest carried. For any other installment that carries partial installment credit while the contract's latest posted payment, returned or not, is dated on or before that installment's due date, the amount is the scheduled installment less the partial installment credit. For every other installment the amount is the scheduled installment.

| Installment charged | Partial installment credit | Latest posted payment (returned or not) | Amount the rate applies to |
|---|---|---|---|
| final installment (due date equals the maturity date) | any | any | lesser of the scheduled installment and principal balance plus unpaid interest carried |
| any other | more than 0.00 | dated on or before the installment's due date | scheduled installment less the partial installment credit |
| any other | more than 0.00 | dated after the installment's due date | scheduled installment |
| any other | none | any | scheduled installment |

The latest posted payment is the payment with the latest posting date on the contract, whether or not it was later returned. The partial installment credit is the installment credit carried toward the installment due on the next due date.

## Questions answered (hypothetical contracts)

*A contract's final installment is due; the principal balance is 141.20 and unpaid interest carried is 2.35, against a scheduled installment of 389.00. What amount is the rate applied to?* The lesser of 389.00 and 143.55, that is 143.55.

*An installment due 8 May carries 120.00 of partial credit from a payment posted 2 May, against a scheduled installment of 389.00.* The payment is dated on or before the due date, so the amount is 389.00 less 120.00, that is 269.00.

*The same 120.00 of partial credit came from a payment posted 11 May, after the 8 May due date.* The latest posted payment is dated after the due date, so the amount is the full 389.00.

*A payment posted on the due date itself.* It is dated on or before the due date, so the partial credit is deducted.
